facts.fact: The ID4Africa deck says Tunisia's Mobile ID, in service since August 2022, lets citizens authenticate reliably to access online services, linking the unique citizen identifier, a mobile number and an electronic certificate.

The deck says services using the unique citizen identifier and Mobile ID include online school enrolment, the education portal, the citizen services portal, online civil status extracts and the vehicle e-contract.
The deck says Mobile ID, in service since August 2022, is a digital identity on the mobile phone tying the identifier, phone number, electronic certificate and an electronic wallet.
